description: Bombee default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/bombee-character-sheet.png (intake.json swatch chips cream 253,235,207 / yellow 254,198,92 / black 45,41,40 / tan 229,190,148 / blush 249,169,141, plus direct samples of the drawn surfaces; sampler: service venv PIL, medians of masked boxes). Cream face disc, bold black + yellow bands wrapping behind it and circling the stinger, cream-tan stinger + spikes, slightly translucent cream wings with a tan diamond vein lattice and a brown outline, dark-brown eyes (dark rim, brown iris, dark pupil, white highlight), dark smile line, pink blush. No glow (the sheet draws none). Wings see-through via 'alpha' (0-1, written to Col alpha = glTF COLOR_0.a; the wing material is alphaMode BLEND double-sided); material.alpha multiplies it (one knob for 'more / less see-through').

face.note: face disc (cream) chip 253,235,207; drawn side face 252,234,202 (box x900-950 y450-520 median)

black.note: black bands chip 45,41,40 (inferred by spacing in intake); drawn back view 43,37,34 (box x470-500 y520-580)

yellow.note: yellow bands chip 254,198,92; drawn back view 253,197,90 (box x600-625 y470-515)

stinger.note: stinger (cream-tan): drawn side-view stinger median 247,220,179 (box x1165-1215 y465-495); back view 245,220,180

spike.note: foot spikes (cream-tan, a step darker): drawn medians side 239,206,165 / back 235,202,162

wing.note: wing membrane (slightly translucent cream): drawn back-view wing interior median 246,229,208 (min channel > 200, no vein pixels); alpha 0.8 = 'slightly translucent'

wing_vein.note: diamond vein lattice: the sheet's tan chip 229,190,148 (drawn vein pixels p10 213,184,155 / median 235,210,182 are anti-aliased into the membrane)

wing_rim.note: the wing's thin brown outline: drawn outline median 82,58,42 (back view, sum < 330, warm)

eye.note: eye rim / pupil (near-black brown): drawn eye dark pixels median side 37,23,16 / front 33,19,14

eye_hi.note: eye highlight (white dot): face-detail panel brightest in-eye pixels median 250,244,240
